mapper.insert: INSERT INTO games (started_at, ended_at, rounds, winner) VALUES (#{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{rounds}, #{winner})
INSERT INTO game_scores (game_id, player, score) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{player}, #{score})
mapper.select: SELECT id, started_at, ended_at, rounds, winner FROM games ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT winner, COUNT(*) as wins FROM games WHERE winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner ORDER BY wins DESC
SELECT player, SUM(score) as total_score FROM game_scores GROUP BY player ORDER BY total_score DESC LIMIT 10
